(rule! (lambda (grid)
  (let* ((height (rows grid))
         (width (cols grid))
         (separator-row
           (first
             (first
               (filter (lambda (row-info) (= (second row-info) 9))
                       (full-rows grid)))))
         (template-grid
           (crop-to-content
             (keep-only
               (subgrid grid 0 0 (- separator-row 1) (- width 1))
               1)))
         (template-shape
           (grid-from-fn (rows template-grid) (cols template-grid)
             (lambda (row col)
               (if (= (cell-at template-grid row col) 0) 0 1))))
         (lower-grid
           (subgrid grid (+ separator-row 1) 0 (- height 1) (- width 1)))
         (candidate-objs (objects lower-grid 0)))
    (define (normalize-shape shape-grid)
      (grid-from-fn (rows shape-grid) (cols shape-grid)
        (lambda (row col)
          (if (= (cell-at shape-grid row col) 0) 0 1))))
    (define (same-shape? shape-a shape-b)
      (and (= (rows shape-a) (rows shape-b))
           (= (cols shape-a) (cols shape-b))
           (= (length (grid-colors (grid-xor shape-a shape-b 0))) 1)
           (= (first (grid-colors (grid-xor shape-a shape-b 0))) 0)))
    (define (matches-template? obj)
      (let* ((shape-grid
               (normalize-shape
                 (crop-to-content
                   (subgrid lower-grid
                            (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj)
                            (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj))))))
        (or (same-shape? shape-grid template-shape)
            (same-shape? (rotate-cw shape-grid) template-shape)
            (same-shape? (rotate-180 shape-grid) template-shape)
            (same-shape? (rotate-ccw shape-grid) template-shape))))
    (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
      (if (matches-template? obj)
          (recolor-cells acc
            (map (lambda (position)
                   (list (+ separator-row 1 (fst position))
                         (snd position)))
                 (obj-cells obj))
            2)
          acc))
      grid
      candidate-objs))))

(rule! (lambda (grid)
  (let* ((height (rows grid))
         (width (cols grid))
         (separator-row
           (first (first (filter (lambda (row-info) (= (second row-info) 9)) (full-rows grid))))))
    (define (normalize-shape g)
      (grid-from-fn (rows g) (cols g)
        (lambda (row col) (if (= (cell-at g row col) 0) 0 1))))
    (define template-shape
      (normalize-shape (crop-to-content (keep-only (subgrid grid 0 0 (- separator-row 1) (- width 1)) 1))))
    (define lower-grid (subgrid grid (+ separator-row 1) 0 (- height 1) (- width 1)))
    (define candidates (objects lower-grid 0))
    (define (shape-of obj)
      (normalize-shape (crop-to-content
        (subgrid lower-grid (obj-r1 obj) (obj-c1 obj) (obj-r2 obj) (obj-c2 obj)))))
    (define (same-shape? a b)
      (and (= (rows a) (rows b)) (= (cols a) (cols b))
           (= (length (grid-colors (grid-xor a b 0))) 1)
           (= (first (grid-colors (grid-xor a b 0))) 0)))
    (define (rotate-by g turn)
      (list-ref (list g (rotate-cw g) (rotate-180 g) (rotate-ccw g)) (modulo turn 4)))
    (define (rotation-index obj)
      (let ((shape (shape-of obj)))
        (cond ((same-shape? shape template-shape) 0)
              ((same-shape? shape (rotate-cw template-shape)) 1)
              ((same-shape? shape (rotate-180 template-shape)) 2)
              ((same-shape? shape (rotate-ccw template-shape)) 3)
              (else -1))))
    (let* ((matched (first (filter (lambda (obj) (>= (rotation-index obj) 0)) candidates)))
           (turn (rotation-index matched))
           (target (rotate-by (flip-lr template-shape) turn)))
      (reduce (lambda (acc obj)
        (if (same-shape? (shape-of obj) target)
            (recolor-cells acc
              (map (lambda (position) (list (+ separator-row 1 (fst position)) (snd position)))
                   (obj-cells obj)) 2)
            acc))
        grid candidates)))))
